jobs.description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

We are seeking a Project Hydrogeologist to join our Engineering, Construction, and Remediation (ECR) team based in Greenville, SC. The successful candidate will be a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and self-driven professional with 5-7 years of environmental consulting experience and a strong technical background in hydrogeology, site investigation, remediation, and environmental compliance.

This individual will play a key role in planning and executing environmental projects, conducting technical analyses, leading field investigations, and supporting clients through all phases of project delivery.

Responsibilities

Partner with Senior Project Managers to develop project scopes, cost estimates, schedules, and execution strategies for compliance, monitoring, investigation, and remediation initiatives.
Apply geologic and hydrogeologic principles to support project design, technical analysis, field investigations, data interpretation, and remediation activities.
Prepare technical reports, project documentation, work plans, and health and safety plans, including Remedial Investigation (RI) Work Plans and Reports, Interim Remedial Measure (IRM) Work Plans and Reports, and Phase I/II Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) Reports.
Plan, coordinate, and lead field activities for site characterization and remediation projects, including environmental media (i.e., soil, sediment, surface water, groundwater, soil vapor, etc.) sampling, logging soil/bedrock cores, indoor air and sub-slab vapor sampling, drilling oversight (boring advancement and well installation), and installation/operation/maintenance of remedial systems.
Evaluate and interprete field data including soil, groundwater, sediment, surface water, and indoor air/soil vapor data assessments; assisting with writing previously mentioned technical reports; and preparing miscellaneous project documents.
Support the planning, implementation, and oversight of remediation technologies, including soil vapor extraction, groundwater amendment injection, and in-situ chemical oxidation (ISCO).
Conduct hydrogeological analyses, site characterization, and develop conceptual site models incorporating site geology and hydrogeology.
Travel periodically, including to remote project locations, as required.
Manage multiple assignments simultaneously while maintaining quality, meeting deadlines, and adapting to changing project priorities.
Independently manage workload and project responsibilities while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary project teams.
Mentor and support junior staff as needed, providing technical guidance and field oversight.
Actively pursue professional development opportunities, expand technical expertise, and contribute to business and project growth initiatives.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelors in Geology, Hydrogeology or related field of study from an accredited university; M.S. or M.A. degree preferred.
Geologist-in-Training (GIT/FG) certification with a demonstrated commitment to obtaining Professional Geologist (PG) licensure preferred.
5-7 years of environmental consulting experience supporting site investigation, remediation, and environmental compliance projects.
Demonstrated technical experience conducting and preparing Phase I Environmental Site Assessments (ASTM E1527), Phase II Environmental Site Assessments (ASTM E1903), and Remedial Investigation activities.
Valid driver's license and current 40-hour HAZWOPER certification with annual 8-hour refresher training.
Ability and willingness to perform field work and travel throughout the southeastern United States.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and environmental data management and reporting tools.
Strong technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate environmental data, apply scientific principles, and exercise sound professional judgment.
Demonstrated quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) experience, including technical review of reports, work plans, and project deliverables.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with clients, regulatory agencies, contractors, and project teams.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple projects, adapt to changing priorities, and meet competing deadlines.
Proven ability to supervise and mentor field staff, coordinate field activities, and make technical decisions in support of project objectives.
Strong sense of accountability, professionalism, and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

Benefits
* :
TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:

Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.

Compensation
: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

Other Compensation:
Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee.

Disclaimers

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
Wendel, an Esri Business Partner and multi‑disciplinary Architectural and Engineering firm, is seeking an experienced part‑time, provisional GIS Analyst for a short‑term engagement. The position will be based out of the Williamsville, New York office, with flexibility for candidates located near other Wendel office locations. This role is focused on ArcGIS Enterprise administration, spatial web services, and cloud-hosted GIS solutions supporting companywide projects across multiple disciplines. The analyst will collaborate directly with the GIS Manager, Developers, and Project Managers to deliver enterprise-level geospatial infrastructure and analyses.

Responsibilities

Administer ArcGIS Enterprise (Portal for ArcGIS, Data Store) within virtualized server environments
Publish, manage, and maintain hosted feature layers through ArcGIS Enterprise Portal, ensuring performance and availability of REST service endpoints.
Build and maintain web mapping applications using ArcGIS Experience Builder, Web AppBuilder, etc.
Convert and integrate GIS data to/from CAD formats and perform advanced spatial analysis (buffering, overlays, network analysis, distance calculations).
Manage mobile field data collection workflows using ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123, including form design and data synchronization with enterprise hosted layers.
Support the GIS Developer with SQL database administration to automate workflows
Conduct client training on web applications, GPS collection, and enterprise GIS workflows for internal and external stakeholders

Qualifications

B.A. or B.S. in Geography, GIS, or related field.
3+ years of professional GIS experience.
Demonstrated ArcGIS Enterprise administration experience (Portal, Server, Data Store).
Experience working with GIS infrastructure in virtualized server environments
Proficient in Esri's full ArcGIS suite including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and Enterprise Portal.
Experience publishing and managing REST services (map, feature, image, and geoprocessing)
Strong working knowledge of SDE geodatabases
Proficient in Python scripting with ArcPy for automation of publishing workflows, data processing, and geodatabase management.
Strong understanding of REST API architecture and experience troubleshooting service endpoints.
Experience with coordinate systems, projections, and spatial reference management at an enterprise scale.
Experience with mobile data collection platforms: ArcGIS Survey123 and ArcGIS Field Maps.
Demonstrated ability to produce publication-quality maps, figures, and visuals for project deliverables.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and on a team.

Hourly Range: $32.21 - $59.13

Wendel is committed to providing fair, competitive, and market-informed compensation. The rate offered will be determined based off the successful candidates’ relevant education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. The rate offered will also take into consideration regional adjustment factors.

This is a part‑time, provisional position with a short‑term appointment. Hours and duration will be determined based on project scope and mutual agreement. Candidates with experience in ArcGIS Enterprise administration and virtual server environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

Hear from Our Team:
We asked our employees to share what they love most about working at Wendel, and the overwhelming response was that everyone loves working in an environment where the team has each other’s backs. They also liked our flexible, hybrid work policy. With nationwide project and office locations, Wendel presents the opportunity to work on an exciting variety of projects with a diverse group of clients. They said they like our respect-based and team-oriented culture, and our transparent communication philosophy.

Helping our employees reach their professional goals is important to us, and we take pride in providing a variety of professional development opportunities. We utilize an annual career development process, for every employee that ensures career mobility, growth, and company ownership potential.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Wendel is an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer and provides a drug-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
